text: Program Description Industrial design major students mainly learn basic theories and knowledge of industrial design, with application of modelling design principle and law of the modelling of all kinds of products with colour, form and appearance, structure and function, shape, structure and material and technology, product and people, product and environment, the relationship between the market, and the unified expression of these relationships in the modelling design of the products of basic skills. Future Career Students can be engaged in mechanical and electrical products, daily products appearance design, can also be engaged in graphic advertising, VIS, product packaging, indoor decoration design work. Duration 4 years
